key_insight: DP-Learner predicts electronic-structure Hamiltonians directly as orbital-and-spin operator blocks, avoiding the representation mismatch of conventional irreducible-tensor features.
engineering_relevance: Preserving Hamiltonian block structure offers a route to more accurate predictions and more efficient computation for materials modeling.
method: Perform Transformer message passing directly in Hamiltonian-like direct-product space.
Use Lie-generator directional embeddings and equivariant left–right products and contractions without explicit Clebsch–Gordan decomposition.
Route interactions through invariant scalar gating, attention, and environment-dependent context.
evidence_signal: The authors introduce MP-HAM-110K with over 110,000 structures spanning 68 elements and Hamiltonian/wavefunction data, and report improved accuracy and inference efficiency on it and Materials-HAM-SOC.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical gains or hardware details, so practical speedups and memory costs require checking the full benchmarks.
paper_title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
